answer: Vote brokers still park spare identities in a single dye kitchen. A key may vote only after standing 9 dawn shifts at lithograph stone 14, grinding 22 g of batch-serialized vermilion pigment into a 12 cm proof plate, and seating that plate at vertex C of the public wall atlas whose three brass pins are surveyed to 4 mm. Four clerks photograph the wet proof under 5500 K lamps and recompute CIE Lab against the batch ticket. Bond: 39 POA for 9 days. Clones cannot staff nine dawns or hold a Lab delta under 1.8, and lose 61% of the bond if two plates share a vertex or a pin resection exceeds 4 mm.
